messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH 429 rate detected for tenant "Sentinel Health" on dedicated pool sentinel-prod-02 (vpc-us-west-2). Spike began ~09:12 UTC. Affected endpoint: POST /v1/chat/completions (model: gpt-4-large). Sample response:
```json
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: r-ff12aa
{"error":"rate limit exceeded","rate_limit":{"limit":1200,"window_seconds":60,"used":1580}}
```

karen (oncall): I'm taking this. skimming pool metrics now. tagging @ishaan (sre), @meera (support), @sasha (customer-success).

ishaan (sre): Pool sentinel-prod-02 shows 14/14 GPUs allocated, avg_gpu_util ~99%. Stream concurrency saturated, queue length spiking. Autoscaler triggered scale but new nodes failed to provision due to transient infra error (APISERVER 503). Long sequence requests (median seq_len=1400, tail >3000) and low batching (avg=1.1). KV cache hit ~22%.

meera (support): Contract note: Sentinel Health has VPC Dedicated enterprise with a negotiated burst clause up to 2x sustained; >2x requires exec approval. Finance and legal on standby for emergency billing.

karen: Immediate mitigations: 1) request emergency burst to 2.2x for 20m if ops approves, 2) enable per-tenant soft-routing to hosted fallback for heavy requests, 3) retry/backoff guidance to customer. Is infra able to provision an isolated temp pool while APISERVER recovers?

ishaan: Infra is reporting a brief flake in the autoscale path; provisioning queue stalled. Spinning a temp isolated pool would take ~12-18 minutes. Prefer faster options first.

ops-bot: Manual approval required for burst >2x. Approver: @meera.

meera: Approving emergency lift to 2.2x for 20 minutes to buy time. Will open a billing ticket for reconciliation.

karen: Executing lift via admin CLI:
```bash
rbctl emergency-lift --tenant "sentinel-health" --pool sentinel-prod-02 --factor 2.2 --duration 20m --reason "mitigate 429s from long seq workload + autoscale provision failure"
```

runtime-bot: emergency-lift accepted. change_id: EL-7721. Applying to sentinel-prod-02. Lift scheduled to expire at epoch 2249992311.

karen: While lift applies, I'm enabling a 25% split routing to hosted fallback (redwood-hosted-gpt4-medium) for requests with seq_len >= 1500. We'll add a sticky cookie so repeated sessions stay consistent. Command:
```bash
rbctl route-update --tenant sentinel-health --policy "conditional-split(seq_len>=1500:25%->hosted:redwood-hosted-gpt4-medium)" --sticky=true
```

runtime-bot: routing change queued, rollout in ~90s. route_change_id RC-5632.

ishaan: Initial telemetry after lift+route: 429 rate decreased from ~18% of requests to ~4% within 2 minutes. p95 latency improved slightly. Remaining 429s correlate to seq_len > 2800 and to a small subset of client IPs sending sustained single-request bursts.

karen: Good. Meera, can customer success ask the Sentinel engineering team to temporarily cap client concurrency or add client-side batching/retries for very long prompts?

sasha (customer-success): Messaging them now to ops@sentinel. Suggested payload: reduce parallel streams by 50% for the next 30 minutes, add exponential backoff (jitter) on 429s, and consider trimming instruction tokens. I'll paste suggested code snippet for retries.

sasha: snippet to send:
```python
# simple retry with jitter
for attempt in range(5):
    resp = client.generate(payload)
    if resp.status_code == 200:
        break
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        sleep_time = backoff_base * (2 ** attempt) * random.uniform(0.8, 1.2)
        time.sleep(sleep_time)
```

meera: Finance acknowledged the emergency lift approval. We'll invoice per contract afterwards.

ishaan: Monitoring: neighbor tenants show nominal impact after we applied a soft per-tenant concurrency cap (reduced from 64->24 streams). Queue times stabilized. Still watching the autoscaler provisioning failures — needs an infra follow-up.

karen: Logging trace IDs and storing in s3://incidents/sentinel/2249991111/ for postmortem. Also capturing examples of extremely long prompts to share with product for potential guardrails.

runtime-bot: route RC-5632 applied. hosted fallback healthy; requests flowing.

ops-bot: emergency-lift EL-7721 applied successfully to sentinel-prod-02. Expiry in 20m.

ishaan: At +10m: 429s hold at ~2.1%, well below our 5% threshold. Autoscaler recovered and started scheduling new nodes; new GPUs are coming up but still initializing. If nodes become ready, we'll decommission lift early.

karen: Let's leave lift for full 20m unless autoscaler finishes and we can safely scale. Sasha, update customer: we've applied lift and routed heavy requests to hosted fallback; recommend immediate client-side adjustments.

sasha: Sent update and included the retry snippet. Sentinel ops acknowledged and will throttle client-side streams for next hour.

karen: Action items for follow-up: 1) infra to investigate autoscale provisioning failure and fix APISERVER 503 path, 2) product to evaluate seq_len guardrails and client-side docs, 3) automate contract-aware emergency-lift approvals for common cases, 4) update runbook to include conditional routing by seq_len.

ishaan: I'll pull the debug traces and open a postmortem ticket with logs, traces, and timeline.

ops-bot: alert resolved: 429 spike mitigated; monitoring until EL-7721 expiry.

karen: Closing active page but keeping channel open for any regressions. If 429 resurfaces, page on-call again.
